en.invalid_plan: Invalid plan structure or schema version.
en.invalid_components: Components must have stable IDs and explicit technology tags.
en.duplicate_or_invalid_id: Binding ID is invalid or duplicated.
en.unknown_provider: Provider is not in the reviewed catalog.
en.invalid_scope: Capability, component, phase or role is unsupported.
en.stack_mismatch: Provider does not match this component's declared stack.
en.tool_role: Executable tools must use the executor role.
en.reviewer_role: Review-only instructions must remain a reviewer.
en.adaptation_required: Reusing an instruction source as data or review requires a documented adaptation.
en.duplicate_primary: Two primary owners claim the same responsibility slot.
en.duplicate_lineage: Related instruction sources are duplicated in the same scope.
en.invalid_writes: Write targets must be an array of explicit relative paths.
en.read_only_role_writes: Reviewer/reference roles may not write product artifacts.
en.unsafe_write_path: Write target is ambiguous, unsafe or non-portable.
en.output_overlap: Multiple bindings claim overlapping output paths in the same phase.
en.reference_not_executable: Documentation is not an executable CLI or API.
en.unresolved_source: External source is not resolved to reviewed local metadata.
en.unpinned_source: Source must be pinned, not main/master/HEAD/latest.
en.license_pending: License review is not declared complete.
en.scope_pending: Scope and instruction-conflict review is not declared complete.
en.permissions_pending: Required permissions are not declared approved.
en.adapter_unverified: Native/CLI adapter has no declared tested status.
en.invalid_required_slot: Required capability slot is invalid or duplicated.
en.uncovered_slot: A required slot has no selected owner with its declared role.
en.active_conflict: An unresolved host/global-instruction conflict blocks this plan.
en.conflict_without_evidence: Resolved conflict needs a reference to evidence.
en.stale_or_missing_approval: Approval is absent or does not match this plan digest.
en.input_error: Cannot read valid bounded JSON input; no providers were run.
en.invalid: The declared selection plan contains blocking issues.
en.limitation: This is a static manifest check, not proof of semantic compatibility, host isolation, user identity, integration execution or application quality.
en.reference_role: Standards and documentation are references, not execution owners.
en.web_activation_forbidden: Research data cannot authorize activation or assert a completed pilot.
en.web_invalid_scope: Invalid web scope or applicability state.
en.web_invalid_id: Missing, duplicate or non-namespaced research mapping ID.
en.web_invalid_provider: Invalid provider kind or capabilities; explicit normalization is required.
en.web_unknown_provider: Unknown or duplicate target provider in source mapping.
en.web_invalid_role: Mapped role does not match the normalized provider kind.
en.web_unknown_capability: Web coverage references an unknown capability.
en.web_ok: Research mapping is consistent; no integrations were executed.
